title: Lithium and Graphite Update - Benchmark Summit 2026 London
gist: This is a member-only video page for Benchmark head of prices Daisy Jennings-Gray's lithium and graphite update at Benchmark Summit 2026 London. It gives no prices or forecasts. The related sessions listed cover the lithium supply-growth panel, Texas Smackover lithium, Los Azules copper and the UK Critical Minerals Strategy.

insights.claim: Benchmark head of prices Daisy Jennings-Gray presented a lithium and graphite price update at Benchmark Summit 2026 London on Oct 22, 2026. The page is member-only and gives no price levels or forecasts.
insights.speaker: Daisy Jennings-Gray, Head of Prices, Benchmark
insights.so_what: Benchmark's lithium and graphite price assessments are not public here; members would need the video for price direction.
insights.locator: Lithium and Graphite Update - Benchmark Summit 2026 London

insights.claim: Benchmark Summit 2026 London had a lithium panel on the market outlook, covering supply growth, project development and evolving market dynamics, framed as 'The Next Phase of Global Growth'.
insights.speaker: Daisy Jennings-Gray, Head of Prices, Benchmark
insights.so_what: An industry framing of renewed lithium growth is a sentiment signal for lithium producers and developers.
insights.quote: An overview of the lithium market outlook, including supply growth, project development, and evolving market dynamics.
insights.locator: Panel Discussion: Lithium Supply, Strategy & Innovation

insights.claim: Benchmark Summit 2026 London had a keynote billing the Texas Smackover as "America's Lithium Leviathan", which presents the Smackover brine as a major prospective source of US domestic lithium supply.
insights.speaker: Daisy Jennings-Gray, Head of Prices, Benchmark
insights.so_what: US brine lithium from the Smackover is being pitched as a large domestic supply source, which is worth tracking for North American lithium project developers.
insights.quote: The Texas Smackover: America's Lithium Leviathan
